definitions.gloss: Miyazaki (prefecture in southeastern Kyushu, and its capital city)
definitions.explanation: A warm, sunny prefecture on the Pacific coast of Kyushu, and its capital. Known for mangoes, beef and chicken dishes, surfing beaches, and the myths of Takachiho.

notes:
Also a common family name ({宮崎|みやざき}{駿|はやお}, Miyazaki Hayao, the animator).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {宮崎県|みやざきけん}: Miyazaki Prefecture
- {宮崎|みやざき}マンゴー: Miyazaki mango (a famous, expensive gift fruit)
- {宮崎牛|みやざきぎゅう}: Miyazaki wagyu beef
- ⟦チキン→チキン：11029_chikin⟧⟦{南蛮|なんばん}→南蛮：12304_nanban⟧: fried chicken with sweet vinegar and tartar sauce, a Miyazaki dish
- {高千穂|たかちほ}: a gorge and town in the north of the prefecture, tied to the myths of the gods

CULTURAL NOTE:
Its mild climate and sunshine made it a honeymoon destination in the 1960s and 1970s and make it the spring-camp home of many baseball and soccer teams.
